symptom: An image widget with `ImageType: icon` describes as `image image8 (ImageType: icon, ...)` with no icon; re-creating it from that output (drop template + insert in alter snippet) writes an image with no icon and mxbuild fails "No icon selected." once per image, while a second describe diffs identical
cause: The Image widget stores its icon on the `imageIcon` property as the WidgetValue's `Icon` element (Forms$ImageIcon / Forms$IconCollectionIcon / Forms$GlyphIcon, the same three a button's Icon holds); image.def.json had no mapping for `imageIcon`, the engine had no icon operation, and extractImageProperties never read it, so `Icon:` on an image was silently ignored and describe had nothing to print
file: modelsdk/widgets/definitions/image.def.json + sdk copy (imageIcon <- Icon, operation icon), mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (resolveMapping/applyOperation `icon`, via buildWidgetIcon), mdl/backend/widgetobj/builder.go (SetIcon, iconElement, setIconValue), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go (extractCustomWidgetPropertyIcon), cmd_pages_describe_output.go (describeImageWidgetProps -> widgetIconMDL), validate_widget_image.go (MDL-WIDGET22 for icon with no Icon)
insight: The same element in a pluggable widget's WidgetValue as on a core button means the existing spelling and the existing reader/writer (`Icon:` kinds, extractButtonIcon, MenuIconStorageType) cover it — find the stored $Type first with `bson dump` and grep for it before inventing syntax. A property the engine has no mapping for is ignored without a word, so a check that passes says nothing; the round trip only became visible because mxbuild names the widget. The existing check tests had asserted `ImageType: icon` alone was clean — a claim nobody had built.
test: mdl/executor/widget_image_icon_2174_test.go (describe emits each kind; engine Build writes Forms$ImageIcon; Build -> BSON decode -> describe round trip for all three kinds), mdl/backend/widgetobj/builder_icon_2174_test.go, validate_widget_image_test.go TestImageWidget_IconFormWithNoIconIsReported; mxbuild 11.16 on ServiceDeskCopilot: describe-output template replace 5x 'No icon selected.' before, 0 errors after (control 0)
